# Inkabi nengwenya

Sesiswini, inkabi nengwenya babesiphila ndawonye. Inkabi yayingumntwana omncane, oneamandla amakhulu kakhulu. Engwenya yayingumntwana omkhulu, oneamandla amakhulu kakhulu kunaleyo yenkabi.

Engwenya yayidla izinto zabantu. Yayifika kuzo zonke izindawo zabantu ukuze idle. Sesiswini, inkabi ifika endaweni eningi kakhulu.

"Sesiswini, ngicela ungingisekele," inkabi yacenga. Engwenya yabiphendula. "Ngiyakunika izinto, nami ngiyakufika endaweni yakho."

Inkabi ifika endaweni yayo. Engwenya yehla endaweni yayo. Inkabi yadla izinto zabantu. Engwenya yehla endaweni yayo.
